title: Inventory Armor Trims
description: Display full trim decoration in you inventory
body:
# Inventory Armor Trims

**Inventory Armor Trims** makes armor trim items in your inventory look as detailed as they do everywhere else.

In vanilla Minecraft, trimmed armor item icons are mostly separated by armor material and trim material. That means different trim patterns can look the same in your inventory, even though they are visually distinct on the armor model. This resource pack fixes that by giving every armor trim pattern its own inventory overlay.

![Inventory Armor Trims preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/7qPmpSeF/images/81f4153a36a75bc0be376b3ed2deaad6ae0d0fe9.png)

## Features

- Adds distinct inventory item visuals for every vanilla armor trim pattern.
- Supports all armor pieces covered by the pack, including leather, chainmail, iron, golden, diamond, netherite, copper, and turtle helmet variants.
- Supports vanilla trim materials, including resin.
- Keeps the vanilla item style and palette system.

## Why This Exists

Armor trims are already fully visible on worn armor and in other rendered contexts, but inventory item icons lose part of that identity. This pack brings the missing pattern detail back to the item itself, so a Coast trim, a Wayfinder trim, and a Silence trim no longer collapse into the same generic trimmed armor icon.

## Compatibility

This pack targets modern Minecraft versions using item model definitions and item components. Check the listed supported game versions on the version page before downloading.

It should work with other packs that do not replace the same armor item definitions or trim item textures. Packs that heavily modify armor item icons may conflict.
